$comment: Colour Memory (PR Eye Ltd, colourmemory.com) behind a TOON checkout. Prices are in the settlement token's base units: on Base USDC that is micro-USDC, so 30000 = 0.03 USDC. Archive calls are near-free, Intelligence calls are priced per credit. Digby sets the numbers; nothing else in the kit knows about Colour Memory.
